schema: LDC manual correction ledger v1 — every hand-approved text/offset correction, independent of source-extraction lineage. On any future corpus rebuild or lineage swap, re-check this list against the new corpus and reapply anything missing.

corrections.description: 101 mechanical/typography fixes across 98 paragraphs: missing accented capitals (É/À/Ê/Ô on Éternité, Éternel(le), À mesure/peine/Toi, Ô mon, Être), duplicate semicolons (;; -> ;), semicolon/comma collisions (;, -> ;), comma/period collisions (, . and ,. -> .), OCR fixes (ln fine -> In fine, superscript-2 duplication before Viens/viens), one-off typos (missing initial T in 'Tout le reste...', 'appararences' -> 'apparence', missing space after ellipsis in T32.E0024.P021), s'unie -> s'unit conjugation fix.
corrections.source: Originally from LDC_v2.5.50_Corrected_Text_Deep_Audit_Evidence.zip (124-item ledger, audit1) + LDC_v2.5.50_Text_Quality_Fourth_Deep_Audit_Evidence.zip (47-item punctuation ledger, audit4). Audit1 zip is no longer available locally as of 2026-07-04 — rule set reconstructed by exact-string pattern re-scan against the corpus instead of the original paragraph-id list.

rules.note: one-off, LDC.T21.E0021.P011 — regex re-check will always match substring of the fix itself; not a real remaining defect

corrections.description: 49 genuine elision-apostrophe defects: a stray space after an elision apostrophe following a known elision word (qu', jusqu', lorsqu', puisqu', quoiqu', presqu', entr', aujourd', n', d', l', m', t', s', c', j'). E.g. 'qu’ à' -> 'qu’à'.
corrections.excluded: 132 similar-looking apostrophe+space patterns were deliberately NOT touched because they are legitimate scare-quotes (e.g. 'prendre', 'fiat', 'cattiva') rather than elision errors. Only fix when the apostrophe immediately follows one of the known elision words above.

corrections.reason: Jesus-speech segment incorrectly extended into Luisa's first-person narrative ('Pendant qu'Il disait cela, je voyais...') that follows the actual quoted words in the same paragraph. Speech should end at 'pervertit.' (position 109), not run to the paragraph end (399).

Self-inflicted regression: the essuyés word-length change (+1 char vs séchés) shifted the paragraph length but the speech segment end_char wasn't migrated at the same time. Caught by the mechanical-fixes re-scan pass and corrected to tlen (225) — no closing guillemet present, segment runs to end of paragraph.

corrections.description: Full-corpus speech segment boundary repair, applied to the ORIGINAL corpus lineage (pre-EB21) across multiple sessions: 723 start_char mid-word offsets (scan-back to word boundary), 5,368 end_char short errors (3,505 closing-quote orphans, 1,106 mid-word truncations, 759 large-tail closing-quote inclusions), 38 additional end_char boundary fixes (21 over-tlen clamped, 17 mid-word snapped to nearest closing guillemet or tlen), 13 sc/ec boundary fixes. Result: 0 defects across all 8 boundary-defect categories (over-tlen, sc>ec, sc mid-word, sc past guillemet, sc 2-past-guillemet+space, short article before guillemet, ec mid-word, overlapping segments).
corrections.status: applied_to_original_lineage_only — NOT applicable to EB-21 lineage, which required its own independent boundary repair (see boundary_repair_program_v2.6.0 below) since it was an independent rebuild with its own offset bugs

corrections.description: Full-corpus speech segment boundary repair applied to the EB-21 lineage after migration (v2.6.0): 2,437 defects found and fixed (723 mid-word start_char snapped to nearest preceding guillemet/colon/word-boundary, 1,082 end-of-paragraph end_char extended to tlen, 108 guillemet-overshoot end_char snapped back to nearest closing guillemet). Result: 0 defects across all boundary categories, 53,922 speech segments preserved.

Guillemet-balance repair across 531 unbalanced entries (of 2,301). 249 entries fixed with 255 single-character operations: (a) appended missing closing guillemet at end of speech runs that open « and run unclosed to entry end (validated against speech-annotation layer); (b) inserted missing opening guillemet after attribution colons ("Il me dit: ", "Je répondis: ", "proclama: ", etc.) for speech that closes » but never opens; (c) 19 hand-adjudicated cases (speech starting at entry start, laments shifting to direct address, editorial extract, entry-boundary quote splits); (d) 5 leading ASCII double-quotes replaced with «. All offsets migrated, fingerprints/search/norm resynced. 3 placement errors found by self-audit during the pass (T14.E0056, T28.E0003, T30.E0008 — « initially landed on list-items due to non-sequential paragraph IDs / list-colon false matches) and corrected before deploy. ROUND 3 (v2.6.7): 17 more entries / 25 operations — closing guillemets placed at verified speech-segment end offsets, opens after paragraph-final attribution colons, one curly-quote pair normalized. All 33 machine proposals individually read; 7 rejected (speech continued past the proposed close).
corrections.adjudication_basis: Balance of probabilities per Louis 2026-07-04 instruction: source PDF contains formatting/quote/grammar mistakes; interpret the text and make it coherent rather than mirror the source.
corrections.not_fixed: 64 entries legitimate French continuation-guillemet convention; 201 entries remaining for manual reading — see quote_balance_review_v2.6.6.json. Campaign total: 266 of 531 fixed.

corrections.description: 125 cross-paragraph lowercase-boundary candidates (paragraph ends without terminal punctuation, next begins lowercase) reviewed and dismissed: they are mid-sentence paragraph splits inherited from the source PDF line layout. The text reads correctly in sequence. Merging paragraphs would break stable IDs, search records and speech offsets for no reader benefit.

Task A (speaker attribution) increment 1 — English-translation-validated fixes. Set up the English edition (queenofthedivinewill.org, all 36 vols via antiword, date-indexed, 91% coverage) as a validation source; discovered its quote convention (Jesus="..." double, Luisa='...' single) which reliably determines speaker. Fixed 3 entries, all confirmed against English: T4 1903-02-22 P007 (added missing JESUS[0:157] for "Si l'homme ne monte pas...pour lui." + LUISA[201:297] question); T4 1903-03-12 P002/P003/P006 (full-entry reconstruction: P002 LUISA added; P003 fixed mislabeled LUISA[499:652] to LUISA[0:473]+JESUS[490:652]; P006 whole paragraph LUISA->JESUS); T2 1899-05-02 P008 (OTHER->JESUS, "mon Église" speech in a Jesus-monologue entry). Net +4 speech segments; validator clean.
corrections.scan_findings: Full-corpus scan found 719 missing-segment + 63 suspicious-attribution candidates. English entry-structure classifier: 150 M + 3 W in JESUS_MONOLOGUE entries (safer); 541 M + 53 W in DIALOGUE entries (need per-paragraph reading). Confirmed NO safe batch exists — categories mix Jesus/Luisa/narration/nested-speech; every case needs individual reading + English cross-check. Remaining ~600 real candidates = multi-session campaign. Tooling in scratchpad: english_index.py, english_speaker_struct.py, scan_speech_gaps.py, taskA_scan.json.

corrections.description: Task A increment 2 — 7 missing JESUS segments added across T4/T10/T11/T12/T13, all in Jesus-monologue entries, each individually read + confirmed as Jesus direct speech (2 partial spans split at the closing guillemet before Luisa narration: T11.1915-04-24.P002, T11.1916-10-30.P005). Deferred T27.E0031.P052 (ambiguous "Nous le voulons") and skipped T32.E0030.P013 (Luisa thought + narration lead-in). Method: mono-M candidates containing literal guillemets, read case-by-case.

Task A increment 3 — 13 more missing JESUS segments (T3/T11/T25/T26/T29/T30x2/T31/T33/T34x2/T35x2), the divine-voice subset of mono-entry candidates (contain "Nous/notre Vouloir/Ma Volonté/Ma fille"), each read individually. Deferred 2 exclamatory-apostrophe cases (T31.E0023.P012, T36.E0025.P020 — ambiguous speaker); skipped 3 narration/lead-in false-positives (T19.E0021.P052, T31.E0012.P009, T36.E0010.P046).

Task A increment 4 — 12 more JESUS segments from the UNSURE mono bucket (T3/T4/T6/T10/T11x3/T12x3/T13), the unambiguous divine-first-person subset (Je/Moi/Ma/Me-cost). Deferred teaching-exposition cases lacking first-person cues (need English alignment); skipped narration lead-ins and Luisa vision/prayer paragraphs.

Task A increment 5 — 13 more JESUS segments (T19x4/T21/T24/T26/T29x3/T30/T36x2), completing the mono-entry UNSURE bucket read-through. Applied only unambiguous divine first-person / self-reference ("Ton Jésus", "Tu Me sens", "Je/Moi/Mes"). Skipped narration lead-ins ("Jésus ajouta:"), fragments ("Oh!", "Et"), and general exclamations without a speaker marker ("Oh! si tous savaient") which need English alignment.

Task A increment 6 — FIRST dialogue-entry batch. 29 segments across 27 paragraphs (T2/T10/T11/T12x4/T16/T17x3/T18x2/T19/T20x2/T21/T23x3/T24x5/T25), the divine-first-person/divine-we subset of the 104 dialogue-M DIVINE-marker candidates (first 52 read). Two multi-turn paragraphs split correctly: T2.1899-10-07.P004 (Jesus[0:290]+trailing Luisa narration left unstyled); T11.1912-07-23.P010 (Jesus/Luisa/Jesus 3-turn dialogue in one paragraph). Skipped narration, Luisa prayers/questions, creation-voice nested quotes (T2.1899-03-13.P008), and apostrophe-to-the-Will forms (deferred). Reading method same as mono tier.

known_gaps: The original audit1 ledger zip (LDC_v2.5.50_Corrected_Text_Deep_Audit_Evidence.zip, 124-item list) is missing from Downloads as of 2026-07-04. The mechanical_v2.5.63 rule set above was reconstructed by exact-string pattern scan rather than the original paragraph-id list. If that zip resurfaces, diff it against this ledger to confirm nothing else was missed.
27 source-matched title quotation-balance candidates logged by the EB-18 audit were deliberately NOT corrected (no text altered on that basis alone) — see EB-18 evidence if this needs revisiting.

6 dash-prefix speech segments (T25.E0030.P023/P028, T26.E0010.P030, T28.E0001.P074/E0023.P032, T29.E0028.P027) start with a list-marker dash. Renderer already strips it before display, so left as-is — not a defect, just noted for completeness.
